id: # One row per paper. id = IEEE article number (last number in the Xplore URL). Leave a cell empty to keep the automatic value.
# exclude=1 drops a false positive. type = Integer-N or Fractional-N. arch/app take several values separated by ";" (e.g. Digital/ADPLL;DTC-based).

type: pn_off in Hz; jitter and lock in s (85f = 85 fs); p in W; node in nm; fom in dB (negative); spur
arch: fspur in dBc; pn in dBc/Hz; area in mm2. SI suffixes are fine: 5.6G
